name: MonarchInboxRow
title: InboxRow
summary: One conversation in an inbox list: avatar, name, compact age, a one-line preview, badges, an unread dot or count, selection for bulk actions and swipe actions.
whenToUse: As the row of a LazyColumn of conversations, tickets or threads.
whenNotToUse: Not for a notification feed item; use the notifications components. Not for a plain settings row; use a Material 3 ListItem.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchInboxRow(title: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, unread: Boolean = false, unreadCount: Int? = null, selected: Boolean = false, selecting: Boolean = false, preview: String? = null, timestamp: Long? = null, now: Long? = null, avatarName: String? = null, avatarImage: Painter? = null, showAvatar: Boolean = true, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, iconLabel: String? = null, onSelectedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, swipeActions: List<MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction> = emptyList(), labels: MonarchInboxRowLabels = MonarchInboxRowLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, badges: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, trailing: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)
public sealed class MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction { abstract val onAction: () -> Unit; class ToggleRead(onAction: () -> Unit); class Archive(onAction: () -> Unit); class Delete(onAction: () -> Unit) }
public enum class MonarchInboxRowAgeUnit { Now, Minutes, Hours, Days, Weeks }

public class MonarchInboxRowLabels(unread: ((Int?) -> String)? = null, age: ((MonarchInboxRowAgeUnit, Int) -> String)? = null, select: String? = null, markRead: String? = null, markUnread: String? = null, archive: String? = null, delete: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: Who or what the conversation is with. Cut to one line.

options.name: onClick
options.description: Opens the conversation.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the row.

options.name: unread
options.description: An accent dot before a semibold title, and the age in the default text color.

options.name: unreadCount
options.description: A count capsule at the end of the first line instead of the dot, 99+ above 99. A count above zero makes the row unread.

options.name: selected
options.description: Selected for bulk actions: the accent subtle background and a checked checkbox.

options.name: selecting
options.description: The list is in selection mode: a tap selects instead of opening, and the checkbox replaces the avatar.

options.name: preview
options.description: The latest message or a summary, cut to one line.

options.name: timestamp
options.description: When the conversation last changed, in epoch milliseconds (UTC).

options.name: now
options.description: The current time for the age, for tests. null uses the clock, refreshed every minute.

options.name: avatarName
options.description: The name for the avatar's initials and color; the title by default.

options.name: avatarImage
options.description: The avatar picture, loaded by the app. null shows initials.

options.name: showAvatar
options.description: Shows the 32dp avatar.

options.name: icon
options.description: A small decorative icon after the title, such as the channel.

options.name: iconLabel
options.description: The spoken description of the icon, "via email".

options.name: onSelectedChange
options.description: Makes the row selectable by a long press, and by a tap while selecting.

options.name: swipeActions
options.description: ToggleRead runs when swiping toward the end; Archive, or Delete without Archive, when swiping toward the start. All are TalkBack actions.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings, including the age units.

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the row.

options.name: badges
options.description: Markers on the last line, such as MonarchBadge.

options.name: trailing
options.description: The end of the last line: a reference number or the assignee's avatar.

states.name: read
states.description: Regular title, muted age, no mark.

states.name: unread
states.description: An accent dot before a semibold title, and the age semibold in the default text color.

states.name: unread count
states.description: An accent capsule with the count, or 99+, at the end of the first line instead of the dot.

states.name: selected
states.description: The accent subtle background; with selecting or selected, a checkbox replaces the avatar.

states.name: swiping
states.description: The row slides over a coloured band naming the action: info for read, accent for archive, danger for delete. Past the threshold the action runs and the row springs back.

appearance: The row on the surface color; title in the default text color, preview and age in the muted text color, the unread dot and count in the accent solid color with its on-solid text. Swipe bands use the info, accent and danger solid colors with their on-solid text. The same roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web row is a link with an href, an open-conversation state (aria-current) and a keyboard cursor. On Android the row calls onClick and the app navigates; the highlight of the conversation open in a list-detail layout is the app's, as on iOS. Bulk selection follows Android: a long press selects (the web uses a checkbox on the avatar and long-press on touch), and selecting turns taps into selection. Swipe actions follow Material's SwipeToDismissBox, which offers one action per direction: ToggleRead toward the end, Archive (or Delete without Archive) toward the start; iOS offers all three in the swipe, so on Android Delete next to Archive is reached through TalkBack actions or the app's own menu. The age units are overridable together through labels.age; the short date uses android.icu skeletons in the device's locale and time zone.
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack element read as the title with the unread state and channel ("Ana, 3 unread, via email"), the full date and time, the preview, then the badges and trailing content.
The compact age is replaced by the full date and time for TalkBack.
The unread dot and count are hidden; the state is spoken after the title, and shown by a semibold title, so it does not depend on color.
Swipe actions are also TalkBack actions named "Read" or "Unread", "Archive" and "Delete".
With onSelectedChange the row has the selected state and a long-click action named "Select".
The avatar and the icon are decorative; the icon is read only through iconLabel.
The row is at least 56dp high and grows with the font size setting.
edgeCases: A time in the future reads as now.
Counts above 99 show 99+, while TalkBack reads the exact number.
A count of zero with unread false is a read row.
Older than 30 days shows a short date, with the year when it is not the current year.
The title and preview are cut to one line each; badges and trailing content share the last line.

examples.title: Inbox with selection
Swipe to mark read or archive, long-press to select
examples.setup:
var unread by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
var selected by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.code:
MonarchInboxRow(
    title = "Ben Okafor",
    onClick = {},
    unread = unread,
    selected = selected,
    onSelectedChange = { selected = it },
    swipeActions = listOf(
        MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction.ToggleRead { unread = !unread },
        MonarchInboxRowSwipeAction.Archive { /* Archive the conversation. */ },
    ),
)
